additional_info.subject: Notes from customer
additional_info.body:
The connector 1 switchs between the available and faulted states.
After some reboots (remotly and on site), the situation is the same.
I saw the « ougoing coils seem to be stuck » error code on SCB. I
don’t know what it means.
On site, the connector is unavailable but the charger works well
(screen, leds…)
It could be a problem of contactor ?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0384636-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312561850/28]  connector 1 switches between the available and faulted states CRM:00579001207
additional_info.body:
Hello Nicolas,
Greetings of the day!
We have checked in the backend and monitored the charger for a while. Currently we cannot see any error flags on SCB.
This is FW bug and it gets resolved after a reboot.
It did not seems to be contactor fault.
To confirm the same, we request you to monitor the charger for some more time again. And try for a charging session and check if still the charger has same behavior, i.e. whether the connector 1 still switches between the available and faulted states?
If the same issue continues then please let us know.
We will proceed with the further analysis accordingly.
Awaiting your response on this to proceed further.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
